labels.calendarDateSourceSetupGuide:
### Quick guide

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **Name** | Internal title (e.g. *Funds · presentation date*). Shown in list and search. |
| **Start date field** | Which CRM field holds the date. Pick **`dateStart`** / **`dateEnd`** (with time), not companion fields labelled “(all day)” — those are Espo internals and are hidden from this list. |
| **All day** | Export as a **Google all-day** event. **Auto ON** for `date` fields; shown only for `datetime` fields (e.g. Meeting `dateStart`). Do not duplicate “all day” by picking a separate “(all day)” field in the dropdown. |
| **Date key** | Unique technical id per entity + field. Usually **matches the date field** (`presentationDate`, `closeDate`) or `main` for Meeting/Call/Task. Auto-filled when you change *Start date field*. |
| **Display label** | Suffix in Google/event title: `{record name} - {this label}`. If empty → date field label. |
| **Google calendar routing** | **Primary** → main Google calendar. **User picks calendar** → user selects calendar on the record. **Auto dedicated** → uses/creates `CRM - {Display label}` when Admin → Integrations → Google has **Auto-create dedicated Google calendars** enabled. |
| **Sort order** | **Display priority** in the date-source list and Calendar view (not CRM record priority). Lower number = higher in the list. |

**Two-step auto-create setup**

1. Admin → Integrations → Google → enable **Auto-create dedicated Google calendars**.
2. On this row set **Google calendar routing** = **Auto dedicated calendar** (repeat per date source that needs its own calendar).

**Checklist**

1. **Show in Calendar View** checked.
2. Hard-refresh Calendar (**Ctrl+Shift+R**).
3. CRM records need a date value in the visible month.

tooltips.sourceDateType: Unique technical key per entity + date field. Examples: main, presentationDate, closeDate.
tooltips.label: Suffix in the calendar event title after the record name.
tooltips.sortOrder: Display order in date-source list and Calendar (not CRM priority). Lower numbers appear first.
tooltips.dateField: CRM field to read. Use datetime fields for timed events; use date fields for all-day-only data.
tooltips.allDay: When checked, Google Calendar gets an all-day event. For date-type fields this is automatic and the checkbox is hidden.
tooltips.calendarRoutingMode: primary = always main calendar; user_pick = user selects calendar on record; auto_dedicated = create/use CRM - {entity label} when admin enabled auto-create globally.
tooltips.dedicatedCalendarName: Override name for auto_dedicated mode. Leave empty for CRM - {entity label} (shared by all auto dates of this entity).
